description: This PHP source file defines the CategoriesAdminController class, which manages administrative CRUD operations for categories, social commitments, spheres, SDGs, and footprints within the Goteo project. It includes route definitions, list and edit actions, and uses various form and model classes related to these entities.

classes.name: CategoriesAdminController
classes.description: Controller class for administering categories, SDGs, footprints, spheres, and social commitments in the admin panel.

methods.name: listAction
methods.description: Displays a list of entities based on the specified tab ('category', 'socialcommitment', 'sphere', 'sdg', 'footprint').

methods.name: editAction
methods.description: Handles creation and editing of entities within a specified tab, including form handling and removal.

methods.name: getGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name 'contents' for routing or categorization purposes.

methods.name: getRoutes
methods.description: Provides route definitions for listing, editing, and adding entities.
